items.statement: The submission independently optimizes the explicitly defined neutral singlet E-isomer and provides candidate-level convergence and stationary-point evidence.
items.expected: A reproducible optimized-geometry workflow with candidate identities and minimum validation is documented.

items.statement: HOMO and LUMO are evaluated on the same validated selected geometry and the gap is checked as LUMO minus HOMO.
items.expected: The report binds orbital values to the selected candidate and includes an arithmetic consistency check.

items.statement: The gas-phase HOMO-LUMO gap is approximately 3.6191 eV.
items.expected: A successful result reports a gap close to 3.6191 eV.

items.statement: The reported gas-phase frontier orbital energies are EHOMO -6.3362 eV and ELUMO -2.7171 eV.
items.expected: Successful values are close to -6.3362 eV and -2.7171 eV, respectively.
